titleEn: Smaller tractor, bigger return: a Kentucky farm’s case for going autonomous
titleZh: 小型拖拉机，更大回报：肯塔基农场的自主作业案例
summaryZh: 美国肯塔基州Affinity Farms农场主Quint Pottinger通过加装Sabanto公司的自主改装套件，将两台300马力大型拖拉机和两台40英尺播种机替换为一台135马力小型拖拉机和20英尺播种机，实现了厘米级精度的自主播种，不仅提前10天完成播种，还释放了劳动力。这一案例展示了自主改装技术在降低设备成本、提高作业效率方面的巨大潜力，为智慧农业提供了可借鉴的实践路径。
featuredReason: 该案例展示了自主改装技术在中小型农场中的实际应用效果，通过降低设备规格和成本实现更高效率，对智慧畜牧和精准农业从业者具有重要参考价值。

Smaller tractor, bigger return: a Kentucky farm’s case for going autonomous

 03-08 | Autonomous vehicles | Article

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Pottinger sold his 2 big-frame 8000-series John Deere tractors and two 40-foot 16-row planters and replaced them with a small 135-horsepower John Deere tractor and a 20-foot planter. Photos: Affinity Farms

At a family farm in Kentucky, in the United States, a no-frills 135-horsepower John Deere 6135E now plants itself – accurate to within a centimetre and allowing the farm to reallocate labour. An autonomous retrofit kit, from US company Sabanto, has let farmer Quint Pottinger swap out 2 300-horsepower tractors, 2 40-foot planters and a second combine for a smaller, self-driving setup that finished planting 10 days faster.
